title: Deslop Report
description: A report on code quality issues found in a diff, focusing on 'deslopping' or cleaning up code.

schema_version.description: The semantic version of the schema.

deslop_report_id.description: A unique identifier for this report.

status.description: The overall status of the deslop check.

behavior_changed.description: Flag indicating if the changes are suspected to alter behavior. Defaults to false.

file.description: The file where the issue was found.

count.description: Number of occurrences of this issue in the file.

evidence_refs.description: References to external evidence, like log files or full diffs.
